title: Wrong token transfer in `executeWithdrawal()`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `executeWithdrawal` function in the `DepositUSD` contract is incorrectly implemented to send ETH instead of the USD tokens (e.g., DAI, sDAI) that users originally deposited.
